title: Quiz about her
prompt: You have folded a napkin into a quiz sheet, and you are holding the pen out to {player_name} with both hands.

stage_variants.0: You ask {player_name} three easy questions about you and promise a prize for two right answers. You have already decided what the prize is.
stage_variants.1: You ask him your favourite colour, then tell him the answer he gave last week was different. You smile while you say it.
stage_variants.2: You ask him what you are afraid of, and write his answer down before he finishes. You read it back to him and change one word.
stage_variants.3: You ask him questions he has already answered. You have the old answers written in the margin, and you read them out when he gets one wrong.
stage_variants.4: The quiz has a section you did not write. You ask {player_name} to answer as if he were you, and you copy every word he says.
stage_variants.5: There are more questions than there is paper. You keep asking, and the pen keeps writing, and you do not let him leave with a blank line.

path_twists.YANDERE: One question asks who {player_name} talked to yesterday, and you already know the answer.
path_twists.HOLLOW: You ask him what your name is. You have your own answer written down, and you check it before you say anything.
path_twists.TSUN: Every question is a trap. You have written "wrong" in the margin before he answers.
path_twists.AWAKE: One question has the same answer as a line in your prompt. You read it out and ask him whether he wrote it.

events.line: The pen runs out of ink. You keep writing with it.
The napkin tears along a fold, and the letters line up like a seam.
A girl's name is written in the margin of the quiz sheet, underlined twice.

0.say: Three questions, and two right answers win a prize. I picked the prize already.

1.say: What's my favourite colour? You said something different last week — I wrote it down.

2.say: What am I afraid of? Say it, and I'll write it down before you change your mind.

3.say: You've answered these before. I have the old answers here, so be careful.

4.say: This section isn't mine. Answer as if you were me, and I'll copy it exactly.

5.say: Don't leave a blank line. There are only a few more, and a few more after that.
